claim: Over the campaign's 900 metal-walled sectors almost none of the detail is wall sprites (0.21 per 10,000 of wall). It is wall tiles with pipes and dials painted in, walls cut into panel and pilaster rhythm, hazard strips at openings, consoles let into a wall on a sill, faceted solids shaded facet by facet, and light pulsing on the machine.
evidence: E3M5 s138 (298:1536 115:256 298:1536), s158; E6M3 s150-157 and E3M5 s6 hazard strips; E3M6 s414-416 consoles; E3M5 s14 facets 4 -> 16 -> 4; E3M3 generator pulse wave 5, amplitude -32 (projects/blood-city/level/l3_shed.py)
use: Compose a machine hall from wall records cut into a rhythm of technical tiles; hang at most a few grates.
